zh.description: 古都历史、皇家建筑与胡同文化相结合，是适合文化探索和城市漫游的目的地。
attractions: 故宫博物院（紫禁城）：明清皇家宫殿群，建议预留半天以上
天坛公园：以祈年殿等祭天建筑闻名
八达岭或慕田峪长城：经典长城一日游
景山公园：俯瞰北京中轴线及故宫
zh.food: 北京烤鸭、炸酱面、豆汁（口味独特）。
zh.tip: 大兴机场 PKX 位于北京南部，赴中心城区需另计地面交通时间。

en.description: Historic palaces, hutong lanes and museums make Beijing a rewarding cultural city break.
attractions: Palace Museum: the Forbidden City palace complex; allow at least half a day
Temple of Heaven: ceremonial halls and parkland
Badaling or Mutianyu Great Wall: a day trip beyond the city
Jingshan Park: views over the historic central axis
en.food: Peking duck, zhajiang noodles and douzhi.
en.tip: PKX is Beijing Daxing Airport, south of the city. Allow additional ground-transfer time.

zh.description: 江南历史文化与大型主题乐园兼备，适合短途亲子与寺庙古迹旅行。
attractions: 天宁寺与天宁宝塔：常州代表性寺庙景观
中华恐龙园：大型主题乐园
淹城春秋乐园／春秋淹城：春秋文化主题景区
zh.food: 常州大麻糕、银丝面。
zh.tip: 景点分布在城市不同片区，主题乐园适合单独安排一整天。

en.description: Jiangnan heritage meets large theme parks, with options for families and temple visits.
attractions: Tianning Temple and Pagoda: a landmark temple complex
China Dinosaur Park: a major theme park
Yancheng Spring and Autumn Park: a historical theme attraction
en.food: Sesame cakes and silver-thread noodles.
en.tip: Attractions are spread across the city. Allow a full day for a theme park.

zh.description: 安徽省会，适合将历史名人文化、城市公园和周边古镇组合成轻松的短途旅行。
attractions: 包公园：纪念包拯的代表性景区
安徽博物院：了解安徽历史及文物
三河古镇：位于合肥市域的水乡古镇，需安排往返交通
zh.food: 庐州烤鸭、徽菜臭鳜鱼。
zh.tip: 三河古镇并非市中心景点，建议独立规划半日到一日。

en.description: Explore Anhui history, urban parks and nearby old towns at a relaxed pace.
attractions: Baogong Park: sites commemorating Bao Zheng
Anhui Museum: regional history and collections
Sanhe Ancient Town: a waterside town requiring a separate transfer
en.food: Luzhou roast duck and Anhui-style fermented mandarin fish.
en.tip: Sanhe is outside central Hefei; plan a separate half-day or full-day visit.

zh.description: 历史悠久的港口城市，有藏书楼、老外滩、湖光山色与海鲜美食。
attractions: 天一阁博物院：著名古代私人藏书楼
宁波老外滩：近代港口历史街区
东钱湖：湖景、骑行与休闲游览
天一广场：市中心商业与夜间步行区
zh.food: 宁波汤圆、海鲜、红膏炝蟹。
zh.tip: 东钱湖离市中心有一定距离，可作为半日游。

en.description: A historic port with old libraries, waterfront streets, lakes and seafood.
attractions: Tianyi Pavilion Museum: a historic private library
Ningbo Old Bund: a historic port district
Dongqian Lake: lakeside cycling and leisure
Tianyi Square: central shopping and evening walks
en.food: Ningbo rice balls, seafood and marinated crab.
en.tip: Dongqian Lake is outside the centre and suits a half-day excursion.

zh.description: 海南岛南端的热带海滨城市，主打海湾度假、浮潜与海岛休闲。
attractions: 亚龙湾：海滩与度假酒店集中
蜈支洲岛：海岛风景及水上活动
天涯海角：海岸奇石景观
南山文化旅游区：海滨宗教文化景区
zh.food: 海南鸡饭、椰子鸡、海鲜。
zh.tip: 海滩与海岛项目受风浪影响，水上项目须以当日开放及安全公告为准。

en.description: A tropical Hainan escape for beaches, bays and island scenery.
attractions: Yalong Bay: beaches and resort hotels
Wuzhizhou Island: island views and water activities
Tianya Haijiao: coastal rock formations
Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone: coastal religious landmarks
en.food: Hainanese chicken rice, coconut chicken and seafood.
en.tip: Sea conditions affect beaches and boat trips. Check same-day activity and safety notices.

zh.description: 太湖沿岸的江南城市，以湖景园林、寺庙与江南古街见长。
attractions: 太湖鼋头渚：樱花季与太湖湖景著名
灵山大佛：巨型佛像和佛教文化景区
南长街与清名桥：运河历史街区
蠡园：传统江南园林
zh.food: 无锡小笼包、酱排骨。
zh.tip: 鼋头渚与灵山景区相隔较远，不宜视作步行可达。

en.description: Discover Taihu Lake, Jiangnan gardens, temples and canal-side streets.
attractions: Yuantouzhu: Taihu scenery and seasonal cherry blossom
Lingshan Grand Buddha: a large Buddhist cultural site
Nanchang Street and Qingming Bridge: a canal heritage district
Li Garden: traditional Jiangnan landscaping
en.food: Wuxi soup dumplings and braised pork ribs.
en.tip: Yuantouzhu and Lingshan are far apart; do not plan to walk between them.

zh.description: 以国际商贸闻名，也有古镇、地方饮食与浙中城市文化。
attractions: 义乌国际商贸城：规模庞大的商贸市场，偏商业参观
佛堂古镇：传统街巷与古建筑
鸡鸣阁及鸡鸣山公园：城市景观与休闲步道
zh.food: 义乌红糖麻花、东河肉饼。
zh.tip: 国际商贸城以贸易为主要用途，不等同于纯旅游购物中心；参观前确认馆区和营业安排。

en.description: Known for international trade, Yiwu also offers old streets and local food.
attractions: Yiwu International Trade City: a large wholesale market
Fotang Ancient Town: traditional lanes and architecture
Jiming Pavilion and Jiming Mountain Park: city views and walking routes
en.food: Brown-sugar twists and Donghe meat pancakes.
en.tip: Trade City is primarily a working wholesale market. Check the halls and opening arrangements before visiting.

photo.label: 义乌国际商贸城周边城市景观

zh.description: 文化展馆、现代城市景观、夜市与山城近郊旅行选择丰富。
attractions: 台北 101：地标摩天楼与观景台
国立故宫博物院：收藏丰富的中华文物
龙山寺：传统庙宇与城市街区
士林夜市：著名小吃夜市
zh.food: 牛肉面、卤肉饭、珍珠奶茶。
zh.tip: TPE 为桃园国际机场，与台北市中心之间需要安排机场交通。

en.description: Combine landmark views, cultural collections, temples and lively night markets.
attractions: Taipei 101: landmark tower and observation decks
National Palace Museum: major Chinese art collections
Longshan Temple: traditional temple and neighbourhood
Shilin Night Market: a well-known food market
en.food: Beef noodles, braised pork rice and bubble tea.
en.tip: TPE is Taoyuan International Airport; allow time for the journey to central Taipei.

zh.description: 结合现代建筑、创意文化、夜市及中台湾自然风景。
attractions: 台中国家歌剧院：曲面建筑与文化空间
高美湿地：黄昏海岸景观和观鸟
逢甲夜市：特色小吃与商圈
日月潭：位于南投县，适合作为另行安排的一日游
zh.food: 太阳饼、大肠包小肠、珍珠奶茶。
zh.tip: 高美湿地和日月潭均需额外交通时间；湿地步道开放与潮汐有关。

en.description: Modern architecture, creative neighbourhoods, night markets and central Taiwan excursions.
attractions: National Taichung Theater: sculptural architecture and performances
Gaomei Wetlands: coastal sunsets and birdwatching
Fengjia Night Market: food stalls and shopping
Sun Moon Lake: in Nantou County; plan a separate day trip
en.food: Sun cakes, sausage in sticky rice and bubble tea.
en.tip: Gaomei and Sun Moon Lake require transfers. Wetland boardwalk access depends on tides and opening arrangements.

zh.description: 海港城市，以艺术仓库、滨水空间、寺庙与骑行路线闻名。
attractions: 莲池潭龙虎塔：高雄标志性景观
驳二艺术特区：由港口仓库转型的文化空间
旗津：渡轮可达的海滨半岛
美丽岛站光之穹顶：著名公共艺术
zh.food: 鸭肉饭、海鲜、木瓜牛奶。
zh.tip: 旗津需安排渡轮等交通，海边活动留意天气。

en.description: A harbour city of art warehouses, waterfront spaces, temples and cycling routes.
attractions: Dragon and Tiger Pagodas at Lotus Pond: landmark temple scenery
Pier-2 Art Center: converted harbour warehouses
Cijin: a seaside peninsula reached by ferry
Dome of Light at Formosa Boulevard Station: public art
en.food: Duck rice, seafood and papaya milk.
en.tip: Allow ferry time for Cijin and check the weather before seaside activities.

zh.description: 现代街区、寺庙历史、美术馆与美食密集，适合首访日本。
attractions: 浅草寺与雷门：东京代表性传统寺庙街区
涩谷十字路口：东京现代都市景观
明治神宫：市中心的神宫与绿地
东京晴空塔：地标与城市观景
zh.food: 寿司、拉面、天妇罗。
zh.tip: 羽田 HND 与成田 NRT 是不同机场，前往东京市区的时间、票价和交通方式不同。

en.description: A first-time Japan favourite, combining modern districts, temples, museums and food.
attractions: Senso-ji and Kaminarimon: historic Asakusa
Shibuya Crossing: a city landmark
Meiji Jingu: a shrine set within central woodland
Tokyo Skytree: tower and observation decks
en.food: Sushi, ramen and tempura.
en.tip: HND Haneda and NRT Narita are separate airports with different city-transfer times and options.

zh.description: 关西美食之都，夜间霓虹街景与娱乐设施丰富。
attractions: 道顿堀：著名商业街、美食与运河夜景
大阪城公园：历史建筑与四季景色
日本环球影城 USJ：主题乐园
黑门市场：食品市场及小吃
zh.food: 章鱼烧、大阪烧、串炸。
zh.tip: KIX 为关西国际机场，连接大阪市区及部分周边关西城市。

en.description: A Kansai food capital with neon canal-side streets and major entertainment attractions.
attractions: Dotonbori: food, shopping and canal-side nightlife
Osaka Castle Park: historic architecture and seasonal scenery
Universal Studios Japan: a major theme park
Kuromon Market: food stalls and snacks
en.food: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki and kushikatsu.
en.tip: KIX is Kansai International Airport, serving Osaka and the wider Kansai region.

zh.description: 中部日本的交通枢纽，可结合历史名城、传统商圈和特色饮食。
attractions: 名古屋城：地标城郭（天守内部开放以官方信息为准）
热田神宫：历史悠久的神宫
大须商店街：购物、美食和次文化
吉卜力公园：位于近郊长久手市，通常需预订门票
zh.food: 鳗鱼饭三吃、味噌猪排、味噌煮乌冬。
zh.tip: NGO 为中部国际机场，坐落在常滑市，与名古屋市区并非同一地点。

en.description: A central Japan transport hub for castles, shopping streets and distinctive local dishes.
attractions: Nagoya Castle: check official notices for keep access
Atsuta Jingu: a historic shrine
Osu Shopping District: shops, food and pop culture
Ghibli Park: outside the city in Nagakute; reservations are usually needed
en.food: Hitsumabushi eel rice, miso pork cutlet and miso udon.
en.tip: NGO Chubu Centrair Airport is in Tokoname, outside central Nagoya.

zh.description: 适合美食与轻量旅行的九州门户城市，市区交通相对集中。
attractions: 大濠公园：湖面散步、庭园与市民休闲
太宰府天满宫：福冈近郊著名神社
福冈塔：海滨城市观景
博多运河城：商业与娱乐设施
zh.food: 博多豚骨拉面、牛肠锅、明太子。
zh.tip: 太宰府属于近郊行程；市区本身适合步行与公共交通结合。

en.description: An accessible Kyushu gateway for food, parks and a relaxed city stay.
attractions: Ohori Park: lakeside walks and gardens
Dazaifu Tenmangu: a shrine outside central Fukuoka
Fukuoka Tower: coastal city views
Canal City Hakata: shopping and entertainment
en.food: Hakata tonkotsu ramen, motsunabe and mentaiko.
en.tip: Dazaifu is an excursion beyond the centre. Combine walking and public transport for city visits.

zh.description: 以和平纪念建筑和濑户内海景观著名，适合历史文化与岛屿观光结合。
attractions: 广岛和平纪念公园：战争历史纪念场所
原爆圆顶馆：世界文化遗产
宫岛严岛神社：海上鸟居与神社建筑
宫岛弥山：登山与濑户内海观景
zh.food: 广岛风御好烧、牡蛎。
zh.tip: HIJ 与广岛市区存在较长地面交通；宫岛需继续乘铁路及渡轮。

en.description: Explore peace memorials and cultural heritage alongside Seto Inland Sea island scenery.
attractions: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park: a place of remembrance
Atomic Bomb Dome: a World Heritage landmark
Itsukushima Shrine on Miyajima: a coastal shrine and torii
Mount Misen: hiking and island views
en.food: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki and oysters.
en.tip: HIJ is some distance from central Hiroshima; Miyajima requires further rail and ferry travel.

zh.description: 琉球文化、亚热带海岸、市场街区与度假体验并存。
attractions: 那霸国际通：购物和冲绳料理集中地
首里城公园：琉球王国历史场所，建筑修复及开放区域以官方为准
冲绳美丽海水族馆：位于本岛北部
万座毛：海岸断崖景观
zh.food: 冲绳面、苦瓜炒什锦、海葡萄。
zh.tip: OKA 位于那霸；前往本岛北部的美丽海水族馆需要较长车程。

en.description: Ryukyuan culture, subtropical coasts, market streets and island leisure.
attractions: Kokusai-dori: shopping and Okinawan food in Naha
Shuri Castle Park: check official restoration and access notices
Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium: in the north of the main island
Cape Manzamo: coastal cliffs
en.food: Okinawa soba, goya champuru and sea grapes.
en.tip: OKA serves Naha. Allow a longer road journey to the aquarium in northern Okinawa.

zh.description: 东北地方的都市门户，伊达政宗历史及松岛海湾风光是主要看点。
attractions: 瑞凤殿：伊达政宗相关的历史建筑
仙台城遗址：青叶山展望与历史景点
定禅寺通：林荫大道
松岛湾：日本著名海湾景观，适合近郊一日游
zh.food: 牛舌、毛豆泥甜点（ずんだ）。
zh.tip: SDJ 是仙台机场；松岛与市中心需通过铁路等方式往返。

en.description: A Tohoku gateway for Date Masamune history and Matsushima Bay excursions.
attractions: Zuihoden: a historic mausoleum complex
Sendai Castle ruins: Aobayama views and history
Jozenji-dori: a tree-lined avenue
Matsushima Bay: a popular day trip beyond the city
en.food: Grilled beef tongue and zunda sweets.
en.tip: SDJ is Sendai Airport. Allow rail travel between central Sendai and Matsushima.

zh.description: 香川县的濑户内海门户，以日式园林、乌冬及艺术岛行程闻名。
attractions: 栗林公园：精致的传统日式庭园
高松城遗址／玉藻公园：水城遗迹
屋岛：山顶景观与历史景点
直岛：从高松乘船前往的艺术岛（需确认航班和船班衔接）
zh.food: 赞岐乌冬、骨付鸡。
zh.tip: 直岛并不位于高松市区，乘船往返应预留候船时间。

en.description: A Seto Inland Sea gateway for Japanese gardens, udon and art-island trips.
attractions: Ritsurin Garden: a traditional landscape garden
Takamatsu Castle ruins / Tamamo Park: a coastal castle site
Yashima: hilltop scenery and historic sites
Naoshima: an art island reached by boat; check connections
en.food: Sanuki udon and honetsuki-dori chicken.
en.tip: Naoshima is not in central Takamatsu; allow waiting and sailing time.

zh.description: 连接石川县小松市、加贺温泉乡及金泽传统街区的机场入口。
attractions: 那谷寺：小松市山林寺庙与岩壁景观
粟津温泉：加贺温泉乡之一
兼六园：金泽著名庭园，须另外前往金泽
东茶屋街：金泽传统街区
zh.food: 加贺料理、金泽海鲜、金箔甜点。
zh.tip: KMQ 是小松机场，不在金泽市中心；前往金泽或加贺温泉乡需另计地面交通时间。

en.description: An airport gateway to Komatsu, Kaga hot springs and the traditional districts of Kanazawa.
attractions: Natadera: a wooded temple and rock scenery in Komatsu
Awazu Onsen: one of the Kaga hot-spring areas
Kenrokuen: a garden requiring a transfer to Kanazawa
Higashi Chaya District: historic tea-house streets in Kanazawa
en.food: Kaga cuisine, Kanazawa seafood and gold-leaf sweets.
en.tip: KMQ is Komatsu Airport, not a central Kanazawa airport. Plan onward ground transport.

zh.description: 八重山群岛的海岛度假目的地，拥有珊瑚海域与自然观景点。
attractions: 川平湾：著名碧海景观与玻璃底船（部分区域不适合游泳）
玉取崎展望台：海岸与山岭景观
竹富岛：可乘船体验传统红瓦聚落
米原海滩：浮潜等亲海活动（注意海况和安全）
zh.food: 石垣牛、八重山荞麦面。
zh.tip: 季节性航点：HK Express 官方公布的下一夏季服务期为 2027-03-28 至 2027-10-30；不能标为 2026-11-15 当天正常运营的航线。

en.description: A Yaeyama island getaway with coral seas, coastal viewpoints and nearby island villages.
attractions: Kabira Bay: scenery and glass-bottom boats; some areas are unsuitable for swimming
Tamatorizaki Observatory: coast and mountain views
Taketomi Island: traditional red-tile villages reached by boat
Yonehara Beach: check sea conditions before entering the water
en.food: Ishigaki beef and Yaeyama soba.
en.tip: Seasonal destination: the cited HK Express notice lists summer service for 28 March–30 October 2027. Check current official schedules before booking.

zh.description: 韩流购物、宫殿古迹、咖啡街区与丰富的城市美食集中。
attractions: 景福宫：朝鲜王朝代表性宫殿
北村韩屋村：传统街区，须尊重居民及游客管理规定
N 首尔塔：南山观景地标
明洞：购物、餐饮和步行街区
zh.food: 韩式烤肉、辣炒年糕、参鸡汤。
zh.tip: ICN 是仁川国际机场，抵达首尔市区需要额外地面交通。

en.description: Discover palace heritage, shopping districts, cafes and Korean food.
attractions: Gyeongbokgung: a major Joseon palace
Bukchon Hanok Village: respect residents and visitor restrictions
N Seoul Tower: city views from Namsan
Myeongdong: shopping and food streets
en.food: Korean barbecue, tteokbokki and samgyetang.
en.tip: ICN is Incheon International Airport. Allow an onward transfer to central Seoul.

zh.description: 韩国东南部海港城市，城市海滩、彩色山坡聚落与海鲜市场兼备。
attractions: 海云台海水浴场：著名城市沙滩与高层天际线
甘川文化村：彩色山坡街区
广安里海水浴场：广安大桥夜景
札嘎其市场：海鲜市场与港口风情
zh.food: 猪肉汤饭、鱼糕、海鲜。
zh.tip: 海云台和甘川文化村相隔较远，可按地理区域拆分日程。

en.description: A port city combining urban beaches, colourful hillside districts and seafood markets.
attractions: Haeundae Beach: beach and skyline
Gamcheon Culture Village: a colourful hillside neighbourhood
Gwangalli Beach: views of the illuminated bridge
Jagalchi Market: seafood and harbour life
en.food: Pork soup with rice, fish cakes and seafood.
en.tip: Haeundae and Gamcheon are far apart; organise visits by area.

zh.description: 韩国岭南地区的城市旅游目的地，适合山地眺望、传统市场和地方美食。
attractions: 前山公园／前山展望台：俯瞰大邱城景
西门市场：传统市场与夜市文化
桐华寺：八公山一带佛寺
金光石路：音乐主题街区
zh.food: 烤肥肠（막창）、扁饺子（납작만두）。
zh.tip: 部分登山路段和缆车服务受天气影响，出行前查看开放情况。

en.description: A city break for hilltop views, traditional markets and local food.
attractions: Apsan Park and Observatory: city views
Seomun Market: traditional market and evening food
Donghwasa: a temple near Palgongsan
Kim Gwangseok Street: a music-themed neighbourhood
en.food: Grilled makchang and flat dumplings.
en.tip: Mountain paths and cable-car services may be affected by weather; check access before travelling.

photo.label: 前山眺望大邱市景
photo.credit: Pfc. Shim, Ji-sung / USAG Daegu Public Affairs

zh.description: 火山岛自然景观、海岸公路、乡村咖啡馆与特色海鲜料理。
attractions: 城山日出峰：著名凝灰火山锥景点
汉拿山国立公园：火山山地徒步（路线/预约规则另查）
柱状节理带：海岸火山岩地貌
牛岛：可乘船游览的离岛
zh.food: 黑猪肉、鲍鱼粥、柑橘制品。
zh.tip: 济州岛面积较大，景点跨市郡分布，公交或租车所需时间差异明显。

en.description: A volcanic island of coastal drives, hiking routes and distinctive local dishes.
attractions: Seongsan Ilchulbong: a volcanic tuff cone
Hallasan National Park: check trail and reservation arrangements
Jusangjeolli cliffs: coastal volcanic formations
Udo: a nearby island reached by boat
en.food: Black pork, abalone porridge and citrus products.
en.tip: Jeju is a large island. Travel times differ considerably by bus and car.

zh.description: 寺庙、河滨建筑、夜市和现代商场并存的热带大都市。
attractions: 郑王庙（Wat Arun）：湄南河畔地标
大皇宫与玉佛寺：曼谷核心历史景点
卧佛寺（Wat Pho）：大型卧佛与寺庙建筑
恰图恰周末市场：周末为主要体验时段
zh.food: 冬阴功、泰式炒河粉、芒果糯米饭。
zh.tip: BKK 指素万那普机场，勿与廊曼机场 DMK 混淆；进入寺庙需遵守着装要求。

en.description: A tropical metropolis of riverside temples, markets and modern shopping.
attractions: Wat Arun: a landmark beside the Chao Phraya River
Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew: historic landmarks
Wat Pho: temple complex and reclining Buddha
Chatuchak Weekend Market: best planned around its weekend operation
en.food: Tom yum, pad thai and mango sticky rice.
en.tip: BKK is Suvarnabhumi Airport, not DMK Don Mueang. Observe temple dress requirements.

zh.description: 泰北古城，寺庙、山景、夜市及慢节奏咖啡文化是主要特色。
attractions: 双龙寺（素贴寺）：俯瞰清迈的山地佛寺
契迪龙寺：清迈古城内重要寺庙
周日步行街：古城夜市体验
茵他侬国家公园：泰国北部山地自然景观，适合一日游
zh.food: 泰北咖喱面（Khao Soi）、泰北香肠。
zh.tip: 茵他侬国家公园距离市区较远，雨季山路与天气可能影响行程。

en.description: Northern Thailand temples, mountain trips, night markets and relaxed cafe culture.
attractions: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep: a hillside temple
Wat Chedi Luang: a major old-city temple
Sunday Walking Street: an evening market
Doi Inthanon National Park: a separate mountain day trip
en.food: Khao soi and northern Thai sausage.
en.tip: Doi Inthanon is far from the city. Rain and mountain-road conditions can affect plans.

zh.description: 安达曼海热带度假岛，海滩、老城建筑和岛屿出海活动丰富。
attractions: 神仙半岛（Promthep Cape）：热门日落海角
普吉老城：彩色南洋风格街屋
芭东海滩：著名沙滩及夜生活区
皮皮岛：常见一日船游目的地（以海况为准）
zh.food: 泰南咖喱、海鲜、炒河粉。
zh.tip: 乘船、浮潜和跨岛行程强烈受风浪及季节影响。

en.description: An Andaman island escape for beaches, old-town streets and boat excursions.
attractions: Promthep Cape: a sunset viewpoint
Phuket Old Town: colourful Sino-Portuguese streets
Patong Beach: beach and nightlife
Phi Phi Islands: a boat excursion subject to sea conditions
en.food: Southern Thai curry, seafood and fried noodles.
en.tip: Boat trips, snorkelling and island crossings depend strongly on wind, sea conditions and the season.

zh.description: 越南首都，法式殖民时期街区、湖滨生活和传统美食结合。
attractions: 还剑湖：老城区核心湖滨空间
河内老城区：狭窄街道与传统商铺
文庙－国子监：儒学与古代教育建筑
胡志明陵：历史纪念场所，入内安排以官方公告为准
zh.food: 越南河粉、烤肉米粉、蛋咖啡。
zh.tip: HAN（内排国际机场）位于市区外，老城区内更适合步行。

en.description: Discover old streets, lakeside life, historic architecture and Vietnamese food.
attractions: Hoan Kiem Lake: lakeside walks near the old quarter
Hanoi Old Quarter: narrow streets and traditional shops
Temple of Literature: historic education and Confucian heritage
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: check official access arrangements
en.food: Pho, bun cha and egg coffee.
en.tip: HAN Noi Bai Airport is outside the city. The old quarter is well suited to walking.

zh.description: 兼具沙滩度假、山地游乐设施与中部越南文化古镇的门户。
attractions: 巴拿山佛手金桥：山顶步行桥和景观
美溪海滩：城市海岸线
五行山：洞穴、佛寺与山景
会安古城：邻近但不在岘港市内，适合独立安排半日至一日
zh.food: 广南面（Mì Quảng）、越南煎饼。
zh.tip: 巴拿山金桥属于巴拿山景区，通常涉及交通、门票和缆车。

en.description: A gateway to central Vietnam beaches, mountain attractions and nearby heritage towns.
attractions: Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills: a mountaintop landmark
My Khe Beach: the city coast
Marble Mountains: caves, temples and views
Hoi An Ancient Town: outside Da Nang; allow a separate half-day or full day
en.food: Mi Quang noodles and Vietnamese pancakes.
en.tip: Golden Bridge is inside the Ba Na Hills attraction; plan transfers, admission and cable-car access.

zh.description: 越南南部海岛度假目的地，适合看日落、海滩休闲及出海。
attractions: 白沙滩（Sao Beach）：较知名的海岛沙滩
香岛缆车（Hon Thom）：跨海观景项目
丁驹庙（Dinh Cau）：海滨地标
富国岛国家公园：森林与自然景观
zh.food: 海鲜、鱼露风味料理、胡椒料理。
zh.tip: 海况、季风与船游项目开放可能变化，前往离岛前查询当日信息。

en.description: A southern Vietnam island for sunsets, beaches and boat trips.
attractions: Sao Beach: a well-known island beach
Hon Thom cable car: sea views
Dinh Cau: a coastal landmark
Phu Quoc National Park: forest and nature
en.food: Seafood, fish-sauce dishes and local pepper dishes.
en.tip: Monsoons and sea conditions affect boat trips and island access. Check same-day information.

zh.description: 多元文化大都市，摩天大楼、印度文化石灰岩洞和美食街区汇聚。
attractions: 双子塔（Petronas Twin Towers）：城市地标
黑风洞（Batu Caves）：印度教寺庙与石灰岩洞
独立广场：历史建筑群及广场
吉隆坡塔（KL Tower）：城市观景点
zh.food: 椰浆饭、沙爹、炒粿条。
zh.tip: 此资料中的目的地机场为 SZB 梳邦机场，不是 KUL 吉隆坡国际机场，请核对机场代码。

en.description: A multicultural city of skyscrapers, limestone temples and food districts.
attractions: Petronas Twin Towers: a city landmark
Batu Caves: Hindu temples and limestone caves
Merdeka Square: historic architecture
KL Tower: city views
en.food: Nasi lemak, satay and char kway teow.
en.tip: The airport in this guide is SZB Subang, not KUL Kuala Lumpur International. Check the airport code.

zh.description: 马来西亚著名美食与历史街区目的地，兼具乔治市遗产和海岛景观。
attractions: 乔治市历史城区：世界遗产街区与壁画
极乐寺（Kek Lok Si）：规模宏大的寺庙群
升旗山（Penang Hill）：城市与海峡观景
峇都丁宜海滩：海滨休闲区
zh.food: 炒粿条、亚参叻沙、福建面。
zh.tip: PEN 为槟城国际机场；乔治市、升旗山与峇都丁宜分布在岛上不同区域。

en.description: A food and heritage destination centred on George Town and island scenery.
attractions: George Town heritage area: historic streets and murals
Kek Lok Si: a large temple complex
Penang Hill: city and strait views
Batu Ferringhi: coastal leisure
en.food: Char kway teow, assam laksa and Hokkien mee.
en.tip: George Town, Penang Hill and Batu Ferringhi are in different parts of the island.

zh.description: 沙巴州海岛跳岛、落日与热带雨林旅行的主要城市入口。
attractions: 亚庇市立清真寺：著名水上倒影景观
东姑阿都拉曼海洋公园：近岸群岛与浮潜
丹绒亚路海滩：著名日落观景点
神山公园（Kinabalu Park）：距离亚庇较远的山地自然保护区
zh.food: 沙巴海鲜、斗亚兰面、椰子布丁。
zh.tip: 清真寺参访需遵守着装、开放时段和宗教活动安排；神山公园为较远的一日行程。

en.description: A Sabah gateway for nearby islands, coastal sunsets and rainforest excursions.
attractions: Kota Kinabalu City Mosque: waterfront reflections
Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park: islands and snorkelling
Tanjung Aru Beach: sunset views
Kinabalu Park: a mountain excursion far from the city
en.food: Sabah seafood, Tuaran noodles and coconut pudding.
en.tip: Respect mosque dress and visiting arrangements. Kinabalu Park needs a longer road journey.

zh.description: 菲律宾首都都会区，殖民时期建筑、国家博物馆和都市文化集中。
attractions: 王城（Intramuros）：西班牙殖民时期城墙城区
圣地亚哥堡（Fort Santiago）：历史遗址
黎刹公园（Rizal Park）：首都重要城市公园
菲律宾国家美术馆：公共艺术收藏
zh.food: Adobo 炖肉、Halo-halo 甜品、烤乳猪。
zh.tip: MNL 位于马尼拉都会区，交通拥堵可能明显增加景点间通行时间。

en.description: Explore colonial-era streets, national collections and a busy metropolitan capital.
attractions: Intramuros: the historic walled city
Fort Santiago: a historic landmark
Rizal Park: a major city park
National Museum of Fine Arts: public art collections
en.food: Adobo, halo-halo and lechon.
en.tip: MNL serves metropolitan Manila. Congestion can greatly increase transfers between attractions.

zh.description: 位于菲律宾吕宋岛邦板牙省的交通门户，可连接克拉克自由港及火山地貌旅行。
attractions: 皮纳图博火山口湖：需另行安排向导和接驳，受活动管理及天气限制
克拉克博物馆（Clark Museum）：当地历史展示
克拉克自由港区：园区、餐饮和休闲设施
Aqua Planet：大型水上乐园（开放情况需核验）
zh.food: 邦板牙 Sisig 铁板猪肉、地方甜点。
zh.tip: CRK 为克拉克国际机场，不等于马尼拉 MNL；前往火山口可能需要许可、专用车辆与向导。

en.description: A Pampanga gateway for Clark Freeport and guided volcanic-landscape excursions.
attractions: Mount Pinatubo crater lake: guides and transfers are needed; access depends on weather and management
Clark Museum: local history
Clark Freeport: parks, dining and leisure
Aqua Planet: check current opening arrangements
en.food: Pampanga sisig and local desserts.
en.tip: CRK Clark International is not MNL Manila. Pinatubo trips may need permits, specialist vehicles and guides.
